depiction.primary_object: horizontal pill-shaped toggle switch with circular knob on right
modifiers: knob positioned to the right (on/enabled state)
depiction.composition: single UI control, centered horizontal view

ambiguity: It is essentially UI chrome (a toggle switch), and unless a task is literally about feature flags, toggles, or app settings, a more specific domain icon is almost always better.

reasoning: The icon is a standard UI toggle switch in the 'on' position. Because it is generic interface chrome representing an on/off setting rather than a concrete real-world object, it only directly fits narrow software tasks about UI components, settings, or feature flags, and for almost any 'turn on X' task the icon for X is a better reminder.
